verdict.rationale: Postman lets users run entire collections (many requests) at once via the CLI/Newman and lets AI-native workflows programmatically manage many Postman assets in bulk through the Postman API (postman-docs-1, postman-docs-5, postman-docs-6, postman-docs-19, postman-docs-42). This directly supports bulk operations across many items (requests, collections, assets) in an automatable, scriptable way suited to AI-native/CI use. missing for 10: no explicit documentation of bulk-specific batch limits/throughput, and no independent hands-on evidence confirming large-scale bulk runs work reliably.
